mechanism: Both drugs inhibit norepinephrine reuptake and citalopram inhibits serotonin reuptake, increasing risk of serotonin syndrome; atomoxetine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which citalopram may weakly inhibit.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, hyperreflexia); use lowest effective doses and consider alternative ADHD medications if clinically feasible.
